definitions.gloss: to be based on, to be grounded on
definitions.explanation: To have something as a foundation or basis.

examples.japanese: {事実|じじつ}に基づく{話|はなし}
{法律|ほうりつ}に基づいて{判断|はんだん}する。
examples.english: To judge based on the law.

notes:
基づく takes the particle に.

COMMON PATTERN:
- 〜に基づく: based on ~
- 〜に基づいて: based on ~ (te-form)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- 〜を{元|もと}にする: to base on ~
- 〜を{踏|ふ}まえる: to take ~ into consideration
